children: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia--Capital A has proposed a court-supervised capital structure optimization of its subsidiary Move Digital, to streamline corporate holdings and resolve historical liabilities.

Move Digital, which holds a 99.56% stake in a digital financial-services platform BigPay and a 13.6% interest in insurance provider Tune Protect, has filed the relevant applications with the Kuala Lumpur high court, Capital A said late Friday in a statement.

AirAsia Move, Capital A's digital travel platform, is directly owned by Capital A and remains unaffected by the restructuring exercise, it said. The platform will continue to operate as usual, it added.

The exercise includes a potential market-driven divestment of the BigPay stake, distribution of the Tune Protect stake and recovery of about 32.2 million ringgit, equivalent to $7.9 million, in receivables. Proceeds will be used to repay creditors, mainly Capital A and related companies.
Capital A said the exercise would help reduce the drag from BigPay's historical operating losses on its financial results.
